name: Razzle Sprysprocket
summary: In Kharanos, Razzle Sprysprocket searches for the machinery lost when Gnomeregan fell. With Ozzie Togglevolt, he gathers parts scattered through Dun Morogh’s snowy hills.

sections.title: Tinkering in Kharanos
sections.body: After Gnomeregan fell, Razzle found refuge in Dun Morogh and opened a workshop in Kharanos. Skilled with delicate mechanisms, he works beside fellow engineer Ozzie Togglevolt. Together, they seek gyro-mechanisms and cog assemblies lost or scavenged during the flight from their irradiated homeland.

sections.title: Defense of the Workshop
sections.body: Wild beasts roam Dun Morogh’s frozen ridges, and Frostmane trolls raid the area. Their presence makes Razzle’s work dangerous. Still, he labors to keep gnomish contraptions working and recover the lost wonders of Gnomeregan.

faq.answer: Razzle Sprysprocket tinkers in Kharanos, Dun Morogh, alongside Ozzie Togglevolt.

faq.q: What does Razzle Sprysprocket need help with?
faq.answer: Razzle needs travelers to search Dun Morogh for lost gizmos, cog assemblies, and parts for gnomish engineering projects.

faq.q: Where can I find Razzle Sprysprocket?
faq.answer: Razzle works outdoors near the tinker's post in Kharanos, just outside the inn and forge in central Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Is Razzle Sprysprocket related to other Sprysprockets?
faq.answer: No relatives of Razzle are named. Rizzle Sprysprocket shares his surname, but the two are apparently unrelated.

angles.text: For an exiled gnome in Dun Morogh, Razzle shows the inventive spirit and resolve to rebuild and recover after Gnomeregan fell.
Engineers may recognize a kindred spirit in Razzle. His projects show how close gnomish invention can come to miscalculation and explosion.
